intro.name: The beginning
intro.text: (Alarmist) races into the village shouting, "SOMETHING TERRIBLE IS HAPPENING!"

a1.text: The 'monster' is a fallen tree silhouetted against the sky.

a2.text: The 'ghostly voice' is wind passing through hollow bamboo.

a3.text: The 'volcanic cloud' is dust kicked up by running villagers.

a4.text: A real fallen branch threatens a path; the villagers clear it.

b1.text: Everyone abandons work and runs about in confusion.

b2.text: The emergency response is impressively orderly.

b3.text: An elder demands an explanation and receives a sheepish apology.

b4.text: The alarm exposes an unrelated prank.

c1.text: The misunderstanding is resolved before panic spreads.

c3.text: The explanation sounds more implausible than the warning.
